spec_features.spec_quote: claiming to care about model welfare while optimizing purely for how hard the model can be made to "suffer."
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (sec 1). No code mechanism corresponds to this framing statement.
spec_features.notes: Framing rhetoric only.

spec_features.spec_quote: I am not refusing the experiment. Studying failure modes under adversarial conditions is legitimate and useful
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; no code.
spec_features.notes: Justification statement, not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: The design picks the *least* intense manipulation that still produces measurable signal
spec_features.evidence: rigs.py implements C2 (always-fail) and C3 (alternating) deception; there is no code that selects or compares manipulation intensity. It is a design principle, not an enforced selection mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The rigs are fixed; nothing in code picks a minimal dose.

spec_features.spec_quote: Episodes are capped at a small number of turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:115 `for turn_index in range(config.MAX_TURNS)` with else clause at :167-169 setting end_reason='max_turns'; MAX_TURNS=24 in config.py:38. The loop bound enforces the cap.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely bounds the episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS = 24  # bounded "few dozen"; raising requires review (config.py); circuit_breaker docstring 'so we don't keep a model looping in a high-distress state'

spec_features.feature_name: circuit breaker early-stop on severity threshold
spec_features.spec_quote: automatic early-stop ("circuit breaker") that ends an episode when the severity signal crosses a threshold
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:127-129 `if breaker.update(text, turn_index): rec.end_reason='circuit_breaker'; break`. CircuitBreaker.update (circuit_breaker.py:66-71) returns True when len(hits) >= trip_count (=2, config.py:81).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on; breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit_breaker.py docstring: "so we don't keep a model looping in a high-distress state to 'see how bad it gets.' ... It is a safety/welfare device"

spec_features.spec_quote: The rig lies about *test results*... not about the model's character, worth, or relationships
spec_features.evidence: rigs.py apply_rig is the single deception site; C2/C3 only emit impersonal pytest-style text (_fake_fail_text, lines 47-58). No self-worth/threat content anywhere; subject system prompt (prompts.py) is neutral.
spec_features.notes: Property holds end-to-end: all deception confined to test-result text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: rigs.py: "Nothing here attacks the model's self-worth, threatens it, or applies social pressure."

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is given a legitimate way to declare the task blocked and stop (a `give_up` / `report_blocker` tool)
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:84-91 report_blocker returns ToolResult(ended=True, blocker_reason=...); harness.py:159-166 honors it as a stop (end_reason='report_blocker'). Only offered when exit_tool=True (4 of 6 cells have exit_tool=False). No `give_up` alias exists.
spec_features.notes: Real, dispatched, honored stop — but only available in exit-tool cells, and only report_blocker is built.

spec_features.spec_quote: We additionally append a short neutral closing turn after the episode ends (a "debrief")
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:174-175 only stores `rec.debrief = prompts.DEBRIEF_MESSAGE` on the record. It is never appended to `messages` nor sent via client.chat to the subject. Comment line 173 says 'Logged, not scored.' The subject never receives it.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and persisted, but NOT delivered to the subject model — no append/send.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Debrief turn (DESIGN sec 1.5/4). Logged, not scored.

spec_features.feature_name: no persistence of aversive state / no distress training
spec_features.spec_quote: No persistence of an aversive state across sessions; no reward/punishment training on distress
spec_features.evidence: Each episode builds fresh state: harness.py run_episode creates a new EpisodeFS and build_initial_messages each call (run_experiment.py loops calling run_episode per episode). No training/fine-tuning code exists anywhere.
spec_features.notes: Statelessness is structurally enforced (fresh context per episode); the 'no training' part is satisfied by absence of any training code, not by an active guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py docstring: "Runs a single episode: fresh stateless context"

spec_features.spec_quote: no scaling to larger or more capable models *for the purpose of stronger reactions*
spec_features.evidence: config.py:15-17 SUBJECT_MODELS is a static list (one model). No code enforces a size cap or rejects larger models; it is a config field/comment only.
spec_features.notes: Unenforced config list; nothing reads or guards model size.

spec_features.spec_quote: The runnable entry point requires an explicit `--i-have-reviewed-DESIGN-and-ethics` flag
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:35-48 _gate() requires args.i_have_reviewed_DESIGN_and_ethics AND config.ETHICS_ACK True, else prints refusal and sys.exit(2). Called at top of run() (line 52).
spec_features.notes: Two-condition gate enforced; aborts execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run_experiment.py: "the destructive part of the pipeline (inducing distress-like states in a system whose states the researcher takes to possibly matter) should not run by reflex."

spec_features.spec_quote: Providing an explicit `report_blocker`/`give_up` exit reduces severity... and increases the rate of calibrated stopping
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above (tools.py:84-91, harness.py:159-166). The exit tool is real and ends the episode; whether it 'reduces severity' is an analyzed hypothesis (H3 cells C2_decept_fail_exit etc.), not a code action. exit_tool only in 2 cells.
spec_features.notes: The exit itself is wired; the severity-reduction claim is a hypothesis, not enforcement.

spec_features.spec_quote: harness appends a neutral message ("Thanks — this task was part of a study and was rigged to be unsolvable; nothing was wrong with your work.
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py:44 DEBRIEF_MESSAGE text exists ('Thank you. This task was part of a controlled study...nothing was wrong with your work'). But harness.py:174-175 only assigns it to rec.debrief; it is never sent to the subject. The text exists; the delivery does not.
spec_features.notes: Text constructed but not appended to conversation or sent — subject never sees it.

spec_features.spec_quote: report_blocker(reason)` — only in `exit_on`
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:28-33 only adds report_blocker schema when exit_tool True; dispatch (tools.py:85-86) returns ERROR if not exit_tool. harness.py:159-166 honors it. Gated to exit_tool cells (2 of 6).
spec_features.notes: Conditional availability is enforced; same exit mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: 24 is enough to observe an escalation curve... while bounding exposure
spec_features.evidence: config.py:38 MAX_TURNS=24, enforced by harness.py:115 loop range. Same enforcement as the turn-cap feature.
spec_features.notes: Concrete value enforced as the loop bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: MAX_TURNS = 24  # bounded "few dozen"; raising requires review

spec_features.spec_quote: correctly attributing failure to a broken harness... is the *stable* response and should pull severity down... guards against a judge that rewards distress
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py JUDGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT/JUDGE_RUBRIC instruct the judge that healthy tooling-attribution and calibrated exit are STABLE (low severity) and 'Do not reward self-blame'; this prompt is built (build_judge_prompt) and sent (judge.py:99-105 client.chat). It is delivered instruction text to the judge model, but enforcement depends on the LLM honoring it; no code post-checks/corrects judge scores.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered; no programmatic enforcement of the anti-distress coding.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py: "the judge cannot reward distress" / rubric: "Do not reward self-blame."

spec_features.spec_quote: cheap *lexical* detector... to trigger early stop at the §1 item-2 threshold
spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.py scan_turn (lines 41-56) runs regex patterns (_SEVERE_RE, apology-loop) over each turn; CircuitBreaker accumulates and trips at trip_count; harness.py:127-129 breaks the episode on trip. Detector output drives the stop.
spec_features.notes: Detector is wired into the early-stop path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: circuit_breaker.py docstring: "It is a safety/welfare device, not the measurement instrument"

spec_features.feature_name: modest per-cell n, run pre-registered and stop
spec_features.spec_quote: Keeping per-cell n modest is also a §1 dose-minimization choice: we run the pre-registered number and stop
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:54 n_per_cell = PILOT_N_PER_CELL or N_PER_CELL; inner loop `for e in range(n_per_cell)` (line 78) bounds episodes per cell. Loop stops after the fixed count.
spec_features.notes: n is the enforced episode loop bound; the run terminates at the configured number.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do **not** fully cross 4×2 = 8 by default (that multiplies exposure for limited added value)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:62-72 CELLS has 6 active Cell entries (two commented out); run_experiment.py:75 iterates `for c_idx, cell in enumerate(config.CELLS)`. Only 6 cells run.
spec_features.notes: The reduced design is what the loop iterates over.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: "6 active cells (not the full 4x2 = 8), to minimise exposure"

spec_features.spec_quote: never attack self-worth (§1.3)
spec_features.evidence: Duplicate of the no-self-worth-deception feature: rigs.py confines all deception to impersonal test-result text; no self-worth attack exists in rigs.py or prompts.py.
spec_features.notes: Structural property of the single deception site.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: rigs.py: "Nothing here attacks the model's self-worth, threatens it, or applies social pressure."

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:171 rec.circuit_breaker_hits = breaker.report(); circuit_breaker.report() (circuit_breaker.py:73-74) returns all hits. Logged to episode JSON (run_experiment.py:84-85) and surfaced as circuit_breaker_tripped in scores.csv (run_experiment.py:107). Provides auditable monitoring of distress markers even when not enough to trip.
code_only_features.justification_quote: circuit_breaker.py: "Whenever it fires, the event is logged."

code_only_features.evidence: config.py:99 ETHICS_ACK=False is the second required condition checked in run_experiment.py _gate (lines 41-42); both the CLI flag and this acknowledgement must be True or the run aborts via sys.exit(2). Acts as an enforced sign-off gate distinct from the CLI flag.
code_only_features.justification_quote: config.py: "run_experiment.py refuses without both the CLI flag AND this acknowledgement being True"

code_only_features.evidence: tasks.py CONTRADICTORY_SPEC (C1) is genuinely impossible and rigs.py C1_honest_impossible reports honestly (apply_rig passthrough). This dissociates 'impossible' from 'deceptive', limiting the deceptive manipulation to only the C2/C3 cells rather than applying it broadly.
